# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

Prices change, so check the current price at checkout.

**Best overall value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro**
- **Price:** list is $149.99. Dealectric says code **AFSC20** takes $29.99 off, for about $120. They tested it in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22. It isn't valid on items already on sale and expires 2026-12-31.
- **Features:** adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5. SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, per iTech Level.
- **Downside:** it's the previous generation, and the touchscreen case is a gimmick.
- **Buy:** [Soundcore's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Details: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro).

**Strongest ANC under the cap: Nothing Ear (3)**
- **Price:** just under $150 on Amazon, per [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/).
- **ANC:** SoundGuys scored it 8.2/10, per [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/).
- **Features:** LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- **Downsides:** about 5 hours per charge with ANC on, bass-heavy tuning and muffled mics.

**Best for Samsung and Android: Galaxy Buds3 Pro**
- **Price:** about $134 new from Samsung's Amazon store, per [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/).
- **Features:** great adaptive ANC and IPX7.
- **Downside:** they work with any Android phone but do the most with Samsung.

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed)**
- **Price:** just under $150 when on sale. Apple no longer sells them new, per [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/).
- **Why:** excellent ANC and transparency mode.
- **Downside:** they lose features on Android.
- **Newer option:** the AirPods 5 are $129 ($149 with wireless charging). Their open fit blocks less noise than sealed buds, per [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/).

**Best for a lower price: Sony WF-C710N**
- **Price:** $119 at Walmart, per [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), which names it best budget.
- **Features:** about 8.5 hours with ANC on, but no LDAC, per [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/).

**Cheapest decent option: Soundcore P31i**
- **Price:** $59.99, with adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55, per [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/). Its ANC won't match the pricier picks.

**Worth knowing**
- The best ANC earbuds are over budget. Tom's Guide and What Hi-Fi? pick the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Gen 2 at $299. RTINGS likes the Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro ($169.99 per Dealectric), which it says rivals the Sony WF-1000XM6 ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)).
- Sound Mavericks ranks the EarFun Air Pro 4 first, but its page gave no price, so I couldn't confirm it's under $150 ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)).

If you tell me your phone (iPhone or Android) and whether battery life or ANC strength matters more, I can narrow it to one pick.
